# rill Vendor Extensions Index

> Discovery index for rill vendor extensions in this repository. Each entry lists the npm package, a summary, and a relative path to full documentation. Extensions load via `rill-config.json` mounts.

## How extensions load

```json
{
  "extensions": {
    "mounts": { "<namespace>": "<npm-package>" },
    "config": { "<namespace>": { ... } }
  }
}
```

```rill
use<ext:namespace> => $ext
$ext.function_name(args)
```

Extensions in the same category share identical function signatures. Scripts swap providers by changing the mount package.

## LLM (3 interchangeable packages, 6 shared functions)

Single-prompt, multi-turn conversation, embeddings, tool loops, structured output.

| Package | Provider | Docs |
|---------|----------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-anthropic` | Claude and Anthropic-style APIs | [extension-llm-anthropic.md](packages/ext/llm-anthropic/docs/extension-llm-anthropic.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-openai` | GPT and OpenAI-style APIs | [extension-llm-openai.md](packages/ext/llm-openai/docs/extension-llm-openai.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-gemini` | Google Gemini | [extension-llm-gemini.md](packages/ext/llm-gemini/docs/extension-llm-gemini.md) |

Functions: `message`, `messages`, `embed`, `embed_batch`, `tool_loop`, `generate`

Note: Anthropic does not support embeddings. Use OpenAI or Gemini for `embed`/`embed_batch`.

## Key-Value Store (3 interchangeable packages, 11 shared functions)

Persistent key-value storage with optional schema validation and named mounts.

| Package | Backend | Docs |
|---------|---------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-kv-file` | JSON files (zero dependencies) | [extension-kv-file.md](packages/ext/kv-file/docs/extension-kv-file.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-kv-sqlite` | SQLite (single-server persistence) | [extension-kv-sqlite.md](packages/ext/kv-sqlite/docs/extension-kv-sqlite.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-kv-redis` | Redis (distributed, TTL support) | [extension-kv-redis.md](packages/ext/kv-redis/docs/extension-kv-redis.md) |

Functions: `get`, `get_or`, `set`, `merge`, `delete`, `keys`, `has`, `clear`, `getAll`, `schema`, `mounts`

## Filesystem (2 interchangeable packages, 12 shared functions)

File operations with mount-based sandboxing.

| Package | Backend | Docs |
|---------|---------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-fs-local` | Local filesystem (node:fs) | [extension-fs-local.md](packages/ext/fs-local/docs/extension-fs-local.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-fs-s3` | S3-compatible services (AWS S3, R2, MinIO) | [extension-fs-s3.md](packages/ext/fs-s3/docs/extension-fs-s3.md) |

Functions: `read`, `write`, `append`, `list`, `find`, `exists`, `remove`, `stat`, `mkdir`, `copy`, `move`, `mounts`

## Web Search (5 packages)

Web search with provider-specific capabilities. All packages share `search`. Additional functions vary by provider.

| Package | Provider | Functions | Docs |
|---------|----------|-----------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-search-brave` | Brave Search API | `search`, `news`, `summarize` | [extension-search-brave.md](packages/ext/search-brave/docs/extension-search-brave.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-search-exa` | Exa AI search | `search`, `contents`, `find_similar`, `answer` | [extension-search-exa.md](packages/ext/search-exa/docs/extension-search-exa.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-search-searxng` | SearXNG (self-hosted) | `search`, `config` | [extension-search-searxng.md](packages/ext/search-searxng/docs/extension-search-searxng.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-search-serper` | Serper (Google Search) | `search`, `news`, `images` | [extension-search-serper.md](packages/ext/search-serper/docs/extension-search-serper.md) |
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-search-tavily` | Tavily AI search | `search`, `extract` | [extension-search-tavily.md](packages/ext/search-tavily/docs/extension-search-tavily.md) |

## MCP — Model Context Protocol (1 package)

Connects rill scripts to MCP servers via stdio or HTTP transport. Auto-generates callable functions from server metadata. MCP tools pass directly to LLM `tool_loop`.

| Package | Transport | Docs |
|---------|-----------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-mcp` | stdio, HTTP | [extension-mcp.md](packages/ext/mcp/docs/extension-mcp.md) |

Returns three capability dicts: `.tools`, `.resources`, `.prompts`

## Claude Code (1 package, 3 functions)

Spawns the Claude Code CLI as a subprocess. Requires `claude` binary in `$PATH`.

| Package | Docs |
|---------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-claude-code` | [extension-claude-code.md](packages/ext/claude-code/docs/extension-claude-code.md) |

Functions: `prompt`, `skill`, `command`

## Crypto (1 package, 4 functions)

Hashing, HMAC, UUID generation, and random bytes via node:crypto.

| Package | Docs |
|---------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-crypto` | [extension-crypto.md](packages/ext/crypto/docs/extension-crypto.md) |

Functions: `hash`, `hmac`, `uuid`, `random`

## Datetime (1 package, 7 functions)

Timezone conversion, date/time formatting, and parsing via the Intl API. Zero external dependencies.

| Package | Docs |
|---------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-datetime` | [extension-datetime.md](packages/ext/datetime/docs/extension-datetime.md) |

Functions: `iso`, `date`, `time`, `offset`, `zones`, `format`, `parse`

## Exec (1 package, dynamic functions)

Sandboxed command execution with allowlist/blocklist. Generates one callable per allowed command.

| Package | Docs |
|---------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-exec` | [extension-exec.md](packages/ext/exec/docs/extension-exec.md) |

Functions: per-command callables (e.g. `git()`, `curl()`), `commands`

## Fetch (1 package, dynamic functions)

HTTP client with pre-defined endpoints, automatic retries, and concurrency limits.

| Package | Docs |
|---------|------|
| `@rcrsr/rill-ext-fetch` | [extension-fetch.md](packages/ext/fetch/docs/extension-fetch.md) |

Functions: per-endpoint callables (auto-generated from config), `endpoints`
